requests.reply: {"translations": ["A rainy port town. A police car is parked in front of an old clock shop.", "Kaoru-senpai, the scene is here. The door was still locked."]}
{"translations": ["Hmm. Was only one pocket watch stolen?"]}
{"translations": ["The innkeeper, Takanashi, stares at the floor while sitting in a chair."]}
{"translations": ["You've come, detectives. Let me tell you beforehand, don't touch anything on your own.", "Yes, Inspector. I'll be careful."]}
{"translations": ["Stop being a detective. Akira is fine. Especially in front of Takanashi-san."]}
{"translations": ["Understood, Akira-san"]}
{"translations": ["Old man Kotori slowly raised his face."]}
{"translations": ["Akira folded his umbrella and wiped the drops from the floor.", "Akira-san, please leave your umbrella here."]}
{"translations": ["Hikaru, who did you ask to watch the office?"]}
{"translations": ["I'm Nagi. I'm still an eighteen-year-old girl, but I'm responsible. Akira-san, please don't worry."]}
{"translations": ["That's helpful. They can handle phone calls and document organization too."]}
{"translations": ["Chatting is for later. Let's start the interrogation first.", "Akira-san, how about we hear from Takanashi-san first?"]}
{"translations": ["The old man replied in a trembling voice that he closed the store at nine last night."]}
{"translations": ["My grandfather has been polishing that clock for many years."]}
{"translations": ["Yuki hasn't been able to sleep since last night. Her fingertips have been trembling the whole time."]}
{"translations": ["Hikaru, how do you see these footprints?", "Akira-san, these are not the culprit's. The shoes are too big."]}
{"translations": ["Hikaru's observational skills are certain. He's still a rookie, but he's no one's equal."]}
{"translations": ["Kaoru took off his glasses and slowly pressed his eye area."]}
{"translations": ["That watch is also a memento from my mother ▼", "Nagi rushed in holding a wet umbrella."]}
{"translations": ["Panting, he left a voicemail."]}
{"translations": ["Akira-san, the forensics results are out. I will share them with the senior staff immediately."]}
{"translations": ["Listen. ...Hmm. The culprit is inside the store."]}
{"translations": ["The old man's hand trembled slightly.", "Outside the window, the rain suddenly grew stronger."]}
